name: Flex Foods Limited
about: Flex Foods Limited engages in the cultivation and processing of food products in freeze dried, air dried, and individually quick -frozen forms in India and internationally. The company offers herbs, such as basil, borrage, chervil, chives, coriander/cilantro, curry leaves, dill, fennel, fenugreek, garden cress, hysop, lemon grass, lovage, marjoram, mint, oregano, parsley, pimperella, rocula, rosemary, sage, savory, sorrel, thai basil, and thyme; vegetables, including baby corn, broccoli, cabbage, carrot, cauliflower, french beans, garlic, ginger, green capsicum, green chilli, green peas, leek, mushroom, okra/ladies finger, potato, pumpkin, red onion, canned, sweet corn, spinach, spring onion, and white onions; fruits, comprising apple, banana, mango, pineapple, sapota/chikoo, strawberry, papaya, coconut, grapes, and guava; and herbs, including basil, chervil, coriander, dill, marjoram, mint, oregano, parsley, sage, sorrel, and thyme. The company exports its products to the United States, Europe, Australia, South Africa, and Asia. Flex Foods Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
